own_solution.law: For small oscillations, mL_eff^2 θ̈ = -mgL_eff θ, so T = 2π√(L_eff/g). The base length is 0.8 m. Either attached cord changes the effective length to 0.8 m + q.
assumptions: The small bob is approximated as a point mass.
The string and attached cord are light and inextensible.

defect_reasons.failed_transformation_identity: For T9329 and T51B9, the certified answers retain the base period despite the correctly stated wiring requiring T(q) = 2π√((0.8 + q)/9.8).
defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: TABF5 adds brass composition and spherical shape relative to TB53B, beyond restating the same bob mass.
